source: New Jersey Department of Health, NJSHAD (New Jersey State Health Assessment Data) Mortality Count query, county of residence x NCHS major cause group, 2000-2024
note: Counts as returned by the NJSHAD query builder; NJSHAD does not suppress small counts, so 1-9 are exact. A county-year with no deaths is absent from the query result (not suppressed) and is omitted here. Data Use Agreement accepted and logged (terms_log/njshad_agreement_*); terms status stated_review. Counts only. Query: Year x County x one cause group per query (ICDNCHS24 major causes; alcohol-induced and firearm injury from OtherCauses; falls from ICDNCHS113 code 99). Raw capture hash in sources/nj_shad. covid = 2020-2024 only. 2001 homicide is far above other years in Bergen, Hudson, Monmouth, Middlesex and Morris, consistent with the September 11 deaths being coded as assault; CDC's published 2001 county homicide counts agree with NJSHAD (no disagreements), so CDC includes them too. 2009 alcohol and suicide counts run above CDC's in about a dozen counties (low agreement), so the build skips those two causes in 2009.
